column6: Homepage lists upcoming UT SMB Summit & Expo on Wednesday Oct 14; that weekday matches 2026-10-14 and the event site confirms the date.
Official 2026 Annual Convention page at Salt Palace Oct 27-28 with current registration fees and cancellation dates through Sep-Oct 2026.
Chamber registration page for Celtic Bank 2026 Financial Workshop Series running Aug 25-Sep 15 2026, with awards at the Sep 17 breakfast.
UMA Jul 29 2026 release announcing a statewide manufacturing roadshow with SBA and 47G plus Annual Awards Gala in November.
Official portal posts PRISM maintenance 2026-08-19 and a live apply path; program is operating.
Center published its 2025 Economic Impact Report on 2026-01-22 (125 clients served); events calendar currently empty.
Banking on Women page posts a live Spring 2027 cohort with applications due Oct 30 2026 and an Oct 6 info session.

Own domain utahmcl.com timed out and was NXDOMAIN as of Aug 2026; Startup State listing undated; IRS last return tax period 2019; found only a partner-site quote about an Aug 15 2025 national convening, not a current UMCL program cycle.
Chamber event page for Uniting Communities Powwow 2026 at Liberty Park on Jul 24 2026; homepage currently lists no upcoming events.
Official UPCGP page states the 2026 application cycle closed March 31; awardees still file quarterly progress reports.
Pioneer Institute June 2026 article reports Utah currently has the most active US sandbox; official GOEO page still takes applications but lists no dated 2026 cohort.
Official 2026 Cooperative Marketing Grant page: interviews done with 63 partners; recipients to be announced at the Board of Tourism Development meeting Aug 14 2026 in Garden City.
Official homepage dates an August 2025 LDS Church community recognition of the chamber; no 2026 summit page located.
SEUEDD Sept 25 2025 public agenda includes an information item Utah Regional Growth Association presented by Stuart Clason; org site itself is undated.
Official events page lists a Utah's Own member roundtable at Kitchen Kneads on June 24 2026.
Orem/Provo SBDC How to Start a Business 101 workshop dated Dec 18 2025; network homepage also reports 2025 client and capital figures.
GOEO Q4 2025 USBCI results as of Dec 31 2025: 9 loans, 480 jobs, third-tranche request to Treasury; lenders still listed.
Same USBCI program as the usbci slug: Q4 2025 Treasury results as of Dec 31 2025 showing live loan deployment.
Official surplus page posts payment terms effective June 15 2026 and a live inventory/auction search.
SEED (a Center for Entrepreneurship program) accepted Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 internship applications through April 19 2026.
Live index shows 143 August 2026 entries and dated listings through 2026-2027 (e.g. CTO Breakfast Aug 14).
BRC site is live and undated; Launch Series page shows April cohort cancelled with no next dates; no dated 2026 BRC application window or event found after checking plaza and Launch Series pages.
UTIA-hosted 2026 Utah Tourism Conference is scheduled Oct 13-16 2026 at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley; public events template on utahtourism.org is placeholder junk.
UVU press release posted 2026-08-06 names the Office of Engaged Learning (the page subject, formerly Innovation Academy) as FanX Studios partner for Humbug! The Musical.
Baugh Institute ZinnStarter Fall 2026 cycle: applications due Oct 25 2026, finals Nov 18, with a Dec 2 event date also posted.
